a.real.life.guy: Hugo "Owl" Guy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Hugo "Owl" Guy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
adammyers575: Tobias Adammyers stepped off the supply cart at S-S17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Rumour reached S-S17 that the war would be over by spring. Tobias Adammyers has heard it before. So has everyone.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Tobias Adammyers across the shin at S-S17. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Matthias "Brick" Fish of the Hegemony (@totally_geeked_fish). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Adammyers stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Tobias Adammyers before dusk. Tobias Adammyers read it twice and slept a little easier.
ben__stratto: Bram Stratto was a ferryman in Saint-Lune until the posters went up. He came to T-F4 with a pressed cornflower, and within a day the whole squad knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Stratto helped stack spare sandbags at T-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Bram Stratto before the night shift. Bram Stratto folded it small and kept it close.
carwyn1988: Rafael Carwyn stepped off the supply cart at S-C3 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-C3 with the rations. Rafael Carwyn ate while listening to the revised orders.
dutch_1996: The draft reached Q-F7 on Day 9. Ulrich Dutch was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ulrich Dutch wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
fatfrog83: Yann "Crow" Fatfrog arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his brother's pocket watch and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-R17 with the rations. Yann "Crow" Fatfrog ate while listening to the revised orders.
hk16_89: The quartermaster asked Konrad "Mud" Hk to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
jimmysparrow17: Yann Jimmysparrow stepped off the supply cart at S-F8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Yann Jimmysparrow stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The parcel for Yann Jimmysparrow contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F8. Yann Jimmysparrow took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Otto Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy).

Yann Jimmysparrow lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Yann Jimmysparrow before dusk. Yann Jimmysparrow read it twice and slept a little easier. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Yann Jimmysparrow during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
There was no room for Yann Jimmysparrow. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Gideon Jimmysparrow had heard about Yann Jimmysparrow's courage. At S-F8, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Gideon Jimmysparrow. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. The new duty roster listed Gideon Jimmysparrow as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Edmund "Smokes" Rry stood up to sing louder, and Gideon Jimmysparrow fired. Edmund "Smokes" Rry was gravely wounded. The singing stopped.
Gideon Jimmysparrow taught Albin Chloe to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

The Concord sentry, Nils Zczc, shouted once. Gideon Jimmysparrow silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@zczc1317) The Concord raiders came over at S-F8 in the middle of the night. Gideon Jimmysparrow met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
Teodor Jimmysparrow put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Gideon Jimmysparrow helped clear the shelf without saying why.
kevinrey007: Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey joined the replacements on Day 8. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S14 changed before the cheering ended. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey shouldered another load. Mail came up the line with a letter for Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
lucas_davis1775: Day 5: Oskar Davis reached R-F23 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Oskar Davis in the thigh at R-F23. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F23 with the rations. Oskar Davis ate while listening to the revised orders.
Oskar Davis drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Oskar Davis never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

The men at R-F23 heard Oskar Davis call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k). The bearers reached Oskar Davis at R-F23 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k).
Anselm "Saint" Davis put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Oskar Davis helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Anselm "Saint" Davis drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Anselm "Saint" Davis watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
miles.peebles: The new machine gunner is Valentin Peebles, once a bookbinder from Dunmarrow. The corporal asked if a bookbinder was any use in a trench. Valentin Peebles said he would find out.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F18. Valentin Peebles has learned to walk bent double.
rachelejosiah: Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia left an old father who runs the family shop alone behind in Port Abel and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he is superstitious about the number three.
Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

A recruit asked Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F19. Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia has learned to walk bent double.

A bullet clipped Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia's helmet at R-F19 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll of the Hegemony (@dilloncoll2015). Dawn watch. Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Severin Lagbagdotzip, grazed.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia was hit through the chest at R-F19. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl). Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F19. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl).
Konrad Rachelejosia joined R-F19 under the shadow of Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A shell hit the latrine at R-F19. Nobody was hurt. Konrad Rachelejosia says it was the best day of the war.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F19 in the middle of the night. Konrad Rachelejosia met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Roland Rachelejosia took the same post at R-F19 where Konrad Rachelejosia stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
rip_van_winklle: Lucien "Ash" Winklle signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at U-F21 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0: At the depot, Wendel "Mole" Day had practised answering to his name. At S-F10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Wendel "Mole" Day, volunteer number 74, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Wendel "Mole" Day walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Wendel "Mole" Day opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Wendel "Mole" Day kept the tin.

Wendel "Mole" Day had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Isidor Acquillae crossed it, Wendel "Mole" Day fired. Isidor Acquillae was grazed. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Wendel "Mole" Day wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Wendel "Mole" Day put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Albin Chloe, grazed.
A clear shot from S-F10. Wendel "Mole" Day gravely wounded Gustav "Tin" Jul and slid back down below the parapet.

Wendel "Mole" Day was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F10. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon).
Three days with a bandage, and Wendel "Mole" Day is back at S-F10. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Wendel "Mole" Day stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
skin09cymru: On the way to R-C5, Albin "Shadow" Cymru tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin "Shadow" Cymru let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home found Albin "Shadow" Cymru before the night shift. Albin "Shadow" Cymru folded it small and kept it close.
tac_sloth_barringarms: Nobody saw Henrik Barringarms arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in Q-F1, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Henrik Barringarms stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
yaboyslydude: Nobody asked Wendel Yaboyslydude why he came. Nobody in R-F19 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A newspaper reached Wendel Yaboyslydude with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Dawn watch. Wendel Yaboyslydude put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Casimir "Spark" Dominickg, grazed.

Wendel Yaboyslydude sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Wendel Yaboyslydude read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F19 and grazed Wendel Yaboyslydude's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Wendel Yaboyslydude fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Clement Wanter, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F19. Wendel Yaboyslydude took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Wendel Yaboyslydude looked over the parapet at R-F19 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
A letter came with Tobias Yaboyslydude: "I am Wendel Yaboyslydude's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Tobias Yaboyslydude heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
A supply man offered Tobias Yaboyslydude a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Tobias Yaboyslydude looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
zaboravljeninemanjic: They issued Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
First Wave. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a lucky button.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni mended a split glove with pale thread. The repair makes one finger look as though it has been promoted.

The patrol returned one at a time. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni held the entrance clear and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni as a story about a general. The ending was the same.

Someone in R-F12 asked Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni about Greyhallow. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. Hill 304 has been won. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Bjl answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F12 and grazed Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bram Satalik of the Concord (@jiri.satalik).
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni returned to R-F12 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Valentin Carlson of the Concord (@nicholas_carlson). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni was carried in at last. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
